name: Worlds Without Number
blurb: A d20 fantasy game of ruin-delving, strange magic, and hard-won competence on an unwritten frontier.
description: A fantasy roleplaying game built on rolling 3d6 for attributes, adding a background, a class, and Foci, and resolving uncertain action with 2d6 skill checks. Characters delve into the ruins of fallen realms, deal with strange magic, and make their names in a world the GM invents from the setting tables. This rule set covers character creation, equipment, checks, conditions, and the foundations the advancement and magic modules build on.

starting_silver.label: Starting silver
starting_silver.description: Take no equipment package and roll 3d6, multiplied by 10, for starting silver to spend on gear or keep.
